name: Arc UNSW Legal & Advocacy
summary: Free, confidential legal advice for current UNSW students who are Arc members, including visa and academic appeal help.
key: Legal advice is confidential and free for Arc members.
who: Current UNSW student and Arc member
how: Book a virtual appointment online, email advice@arc.unsw.edu.au or call (02) 9065 0900
catches: No advice on tax returns, criminal charges, car accidents, personal injury, business law, wills, family law or conveyancing

evidence.quote: Legal advice is confidential and free for Arc members (you must be a current UNSW student).
